title: Release P007 thin-can size and radial-envelope controls C07/C08/C11
scope: K01-P-007 thin-can OD/ID and P007-side alignment to J2 locator datum B

C07.basis: Unilateral h9 keeps the P007 OD at or below the controlled Ø10.00 nominal, so P007 size variation cannot reduce the nominal external radial gap to P015. H9/h9 is already a controlled project tolerance architecture and is appropriate as a moderate production band pending first-article thin-wall capability proof.

C08.wall_definition: 0.30 mm nominal/reference only, derived from C07/C08 sizes; not an independently toleranced acceptance dimension
C08.basis: Unilateral H9 keeps the P007 ID at or above Ø9.40, so P007 size variation cannot reduce the nominal inner clearance to P008. The resulting size-only wall remains far inside the T07A global static/buckling margin.

C11.release_spec: TOTAL RUNOUT 0.02 | B on both thin-can OD and ID surfaces
C11.basis: Total runout controls the complete cylindrical radial envelope along the thin-can length, including eccentricity/tilt/form contribution, and is more directly functional and inspectable than an unspecified legacy concentricity callout. 0.02 mm is the P007-side engineering allocation; counterpart P008 moving-group and P015 production/alignment allocations remain separate interface-release items and are not silently declared closed.
C11.inspection: CMM or qualified low-force supported total-runout setup referenced to datum B; first-article capability confirmation required.

inner_nominal.note: This is a P007-side envelope check only. P008/guide dynamic alignment remains an open counterpart/interface qualification.

outer_nominal.note: P015 production material, ID lower limit and alignment remain open; this value is not the final system minimum-gap guarantee.

wall_sensitivity.T07A_note: Even a deliberately conservative 0.224 mm sensitivity thickness remains far from governing the accepted T07A screen; no new FEA is required for EDR-029. This is a sensitivity check, not a substitute for first-article wall/runout inspection.

technical_filter.function: Preserve magnetic/containment radial envelope and prevent P007 from being the source of reduced nominal clearances.
technical_filter.manufacturing: Selected monolithic deep-bore + supported OD finish route; H9/h9 and 0.02 total runout require first-article capability proof but are not replaced by a looser guessed value.
technical_filter.assembly: Unilateral size tolerances preserve nominal clearances; C11 allocates P007 radial alignment error to datum B while counterpart allocations remain explicit.
technical_filter.inspectability: OD/ID size plus total runout are directly measurable in a supported low-force setup/CMM.
technical_filter.calculation: Nominal and worst-case P007-side radial checks plus accepted T07A structural margin.

standards_basis: ISO 286-2 tolerance classes for H9/h9 limits
ISO 1101 geometrical tolerancing / total runout semantics
stale_triggers: P007 OD10 / ID9.4 nominal geometry changes
P008 OD8.8 or P015 ID10.4 interface architecture changes materially
first-article process evidence shows H9/h9 or 0.02 total runout is not achievable by the selected route
magnetic or no-rub system allocation later proves the P007-side 0.02 runout allocation insufficient
explicit_nonclaims: EDR-029 does not release P008/guide dynamic alignment or P015 production tolerance/material.
EDR-029 does not by itself close thin-wall supplier/process capability qualification.
The historical >=0.25 mm radial-clearance screen is not promoted here to a formal release requirement because no controlled requirement authority for that numeric floor was found.
